definitions.explanation: A disease of the tissues surrounding the teeth, including the gums and bone. Caused by plaque buildup and can lead to tooth loss if untreated.

examples.japanese: {歯周病|ししゅうびょう}を{予防|よぼう}する。
{歯周病|ししゅうびょう}は{歯|は}を{失|うしな}う{大|おお}きな{原因|げんいん}だ。
examples.english: Periodontal disease is a major cause of tooth loss.

examples.japanese: {毎日|まいにち}{丁寧|ていねい}に{歯|は}を{磨|みが}いて、{歯周病|ししゅうびょう}を{防|ふせ}ぎましょう。
examples.english: Let's prevent gum disease by brushing our teeth carefully every day.

notes:
Compound of {歯|し} (tooth) + {周|しゅう} (around) + {病|びょう} (disease). A common medical term appearing regularly on toothpaste commercials and dental clinic signs.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {歯周病|ししゅうびょう}を{予防|よぼう}する: to prevent gum disease
- {歯周病|ししゅうびょう}にかかる: to develop gum disease
- {歯周病|ししゅうびょう}の{治療|ちりょう}: treatment for gum disease
- {歯周病|ししゅうびょう}{対策|たいさく}: anti-gum-disease measures

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {虫歯|むしば}: cavity, tooth decay — separate dental problem; often paired with {歯周病|ししゅうびょう} in advertising
- {歯肉炎|しにくえん}: gingivitis — milder form, only the gums; one stage of {歯周病|ししゅうびょう}
